purpose: A dated review of the manual event registry (knowledge/event-risk.json). It records what each entry's status was found to be on 19 November 2026 and how it was read. It is not news coverage, clears no stock, and resolves no entry.
how_read: This review ran in a sandbox that reaches neither sec.gov nor issuer sites. One entry (MG) rests on a capture the issuer-evidence collector itself made on 5 November 2026: the response's SHA-256 and byte count, and the collector's normalized text of the document, which is copied byte for byte beside this manifest. The response bytes themselves were not retained, so the digest names that capture and cannot be checked again against them. Every other finding is a web-search result excerpt, named as such below; no page bytes were captured for it and no source was added to the registry for it.

entries.note: The registry ends an entry only with a resolution that carries the SHA-256 of captured bytes. None could be captured here, so ACVA stays listed and blocked, and its review stays overdue. The retained Nasdaq directory snapshots agree that it no longer trades: listed in the snapshot fetched 2026-10-17T00:26:18Z, absent from the one fetched 2026-10-20T01:05:04Z onward. To resolve it, capture the release from a network that reaches sec.gov and add the resolution in a dated change.

limitations: A review date says a person or agent looked on that day and how; it is not a source. Only the dated sources in the registry, each with the digest of captured bytes, are evidence the run prints.
A passed review date never clears an entry, and a current one does not establish that a deal is still pending today.
The registry is a manual list of known cash acquisitions. A stock that is not in it has not been cleared: nothing here reads company news.
